speaker: Doctor
text: That is a helpful start. To better understand your condition, can you tell me if you experience any hearing loss, tinnitus, or a sensation of fullness in your ear along with the vertigo?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). Given the sudden onset lasting only three minutes without hearing loss or other neurological deficits, this presentation is classic for BPPV. Would you like me to order a Dix-Hallpike maneuver or request images to confirm?
